notes: This contract records paired portable C++ TCK witnesses for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.13.5.1 TLS server-certificate validation. The positive case installs a self-signed TLS 1.3 server certificate and matching private key at the RTI process, trusts that certificate at the federate, and successfully connects; the successful handshake demonstrates presentation of the configured server certificate and possession of its corresponding private key. The negative case configures the federate to trust a different self-signed certificate with the same endpoint identity and requires RTIambassador::connect to throw the standard ConnectionFailed exception, directly exercising federate-side server-certificate validation. Both certificates identify 127.0.0.1 by subjectAltName. Provider-specific validation settings and trust-store environment configuration remain adapter-only. This does not claim client-certificate authentication, revocation checking, or overall provider conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::connect using RtiConfiguration::withRtiAddress and RtiConfiguration::withAdditionalSettings; positive case also uses List Federation Executions and its report callback
api_surfaces.source_symbol: RTIambassador::connect, RtiConfiguration::withRtiAddress, RtiConfiguration::withAdditionalSettings, ConfigurationResult::additionalSettingsResult, RTIambassador::listFederationExecutions, and ConnectionFailed
